license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person or combination of persons to engage in the business or act in the capacity of a contractor within this State without having an active license therefor as provided in this chapter

type.quote: There is hereby created the State Contractors' Board to consist of seven members to be appointed by the Governor.

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for a contractor's license or a licensed contractor, each officer, director, partner and associate thereof, and any person who qualifies on behalf of the applicant pursuant to subsection 2 of NRS 624.260 must possess good character.

required.quote: each applicant for licensure as a contractor must have had, within the 15 years immediately preceding the filing of the application for licensure, at least 4 years of experience as a journeyman, foreman, supervising employee or contractor in the specific classification in which the applicant is applying for licensure.

experience_source.quote: each applicant for licensure as a contractor must have had, within the 15 years immediately preceding the filing of the application for licensure, at least 4 years of experience as a journeyman, foreman, supervising employee or contractor in the specific classification in which the applicant is applying for licensure.

exams.name: Contractor's License Examination
exams.notes: Board may investigate, classify and qualify applicants by written or oral examinations; examinations may be given in specific classifications only.
exams.quote: the Board may investigate, classify and qualify applicants for contractors' licenses by written or oral examinations, or both, and may issue contractors' licenses to qualified applicants. The examinations may, in the discretion of the Board, be given in specific classifications only.

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under the provisions of this chapter expires 2 years after the date on which it is issued

available.quote: a regulatory body shall adopt regulations providing for the issuance of a license by endorsement to engage in an occupation or profession in this State to any natural person who holds a corresponding valid and unrestricted license to engage in that occupation or profession in the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 622 - General Provisions Governing Regulatory Bodies

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid and unrestricted corresponding license in another state/territory, possess substantially similar qualifications, have not been disciplined or had license suspended/revoked, pay applicable fees, submit fingerprints, and submit required statements.
requirements.quote: a regulatory body shall adopt regulations providing for the issuance of a license by endorsement to engage in an occupation or profession in this State to any natural person who holds a corresponding valid and unrestricted license to engage in that occupation or profession in the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States; possesses qualifications that are substantially similar to the qualifications required for issuance of a license to engage in that occupation or profession in this State
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 622 - General Provisions Governing Regulatory Bodies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract for the project or operation or any modification of the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project with reasonable diligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and prejudicial departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and prejudicial departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner or the owner's authorized representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the State or any political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the State or of any political subdivision thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of money or property received for completion of a specific construction project to any other purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of money or property received for the completion of a specific construction project or operation or for a specified purpose in the completion of any construction project or operation to any other construction project or operation, obligation or purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any money when due for materials or services rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure by any licensee or agent or officer thereof to pay any money when due for any materials or services rendered in connection with the licensee's operations as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep records showing all contracts, documents, receipts and disbursements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep records showing all contracts, documents, receipts and disbursements by a licensee of all of the licensee's transactions as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or omission of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in connection with information furnished to the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or omission of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in connection with any information or evidence furnished the Board in connection with official matters of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep in force the required bond or cash deposit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep in force the bond or cash deposit pursuant to NRS 624.270 for the full period required by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under a license except in the name of the licensee as set forth on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued hereunder except in the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor beyond the scope of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor beyond the scope of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor while that contractor is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor while that contractor is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any fraudulent or deceitful act committed in the capacity of a contractor, including misrepresentation or omission of a material fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fraudulent or deceitful act committed in the capacity of a contractor, including, without limitation, misrepresentation or the omission of a material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of a contractor or a crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of a violation of NRS 624.730, or a conviction in this State or any other jurisdiction of a felony relating to the practice of a contractor or a crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Workmanship which is not commensurate with standards of the trade in general or which is below applicable building or construction codes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Workmanship which is not commensurate with standards of the trade in general or which is below the standards in the building or construction codes adopted by the city or county in which the work is performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting, offering to contract or submitting a bid as a contractor if the contractor's license has been suspended or revoked or is inactive.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting, offering to contract or submitting a bid as a contractor if the contractor's license has been suspended or revoked pursuant to NRS 624.300; or is inactive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with an order of the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to comply with an order of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation or other disciplinary action taken by another state against a contractor based on a license issued by that state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The suspension, revocation or other disciplinary action taken by another state against a contractor based on a license issued by that state if the contractor is licensed in this State or applies for a license in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to file or maintain in full force the required industrial insurance and insurance for occupational diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by an applicant or holder of a contractor's license to file or maintain in full force the required industrial insurance and insurance for occupational diseases constitutes cause for the Board to deny, revoke, suspend, refuse to renew or otherwise discipline the person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Stating that service, replacement parts, equipment or repairs are needed when they are not, or making false or misleading statements to induce use of services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When a contractor states that service, replacement parts, equipment or repairs are needed when such service, replacement parts, equipment or repairs actually are not needed.

bonding_required.quote: Before issuing a contractor's license to any applicant, the Board shall require that the applicant file with the Board a surety bond in a form acceptable to the Board executed by the contractor as principal with a corporation authorized to transact surety business in the State of Nevada as surety

insurance_required.quote: Before granting an original or renewal of a contractor's license to any applicant, the Board shall require that the applicant submit to the Board proof of industrial insurance and insurance for occupational diseases which covers the applicant's employees

definition_quote.value: A contractor is any person, except a registered architect or a licensed professional engineer, acting solely in a professional capacity, who undertakes to, offers to undertake to, purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself, herself or itself or by or through an employee or employees of the contractor or of another contractor, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof
definition_quote.quote: A contractor is any person, except a registered architect or a licensed professional engineer, acting solely in a professional capacity, who undertakes to, offers to undertake to, purports to have the capacity to undertake to, or submits a bid to, or does himself, herself or itself or by or through an employee or employees of the contractor or of another contractor, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement, or to do any part thereof

methods_authorized.quote: For the purpose of classification, the contracting business includes the following branches: (a) General engineering contracting. (b) General building contracting. (c) Specialty contracting.

license_tiers.quote: For the purpose of classification, the contracting business includes the following branches: (a) General engineering contracting. (b) General building contracting. (c) Specialty contracting.

qualifier_required.quote: An applicant or licensee may qualify in regard to his or her experience and knowledge in the following ways: (a) If a natural person, the applicant or licensee may qualify by personal appearance or by the appearance of his or her responsible managing employee. (b) If a copartnership, a corporation or any other combination or organization, it may qualify by the appearance of the responsible managing officer or member of the personnel of the applicant firm.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: the licensee shall notify the Board in writing within 10 days after the cessation of association or employment.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the license remains in force for a reasonable length of time to be set by the Board, but not exceeding 30 days after the date of the cessation of association or employment.

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: The Board may establish a program for the issuance of a license in an expedited manner.

national_electrical_code_reference.quote: Workmanship which is not commensurate with standards of the trade in general or which is below the standards in the building or construction codes adopted by the city or county in which the work is performed. If no applicable building or construction code has been adopted locally, then workmanship must meet the standards prescribed in the Uniform Plumbing Code, National Electrical Code, International Building Code or International Residential Code

utility_worker_exemption.quote: Work performed exclusively by a public utility operating pursuant to the regulations of the Public Utilities Commission of Nevada on construction, maintenance and development work incidental to its business.

financial_responsibility_bond_option.quote: Before issuing a contractor's license to any applicant, the Board shall require that the applicant file with the Board a surety bond in a form acceptable to the Board executed by the contractor as principal with a corporation authorized to transact surety business in the State of Nevada as surety; or in lieu of such a bond, establish with the Board a cash deposit as provided in this section.
